title: Imagery as Color
slide_intent: Teach designers to let a consistent ground support the less predictable hues in food. A viewer can recognize the brand and still experience the variety of what it sells.
strategic_value: Kale and Cashew can give Instacart a visual signature while a changing cast of meals and drawings supplies the color of each story.
demonstration: Three overlapping columns of circles set brand swatches beside photographic details and illustrations. Plus signs join the columns into a visual equation.
practical_value: Choose a core ground and let the subject introduce the remaining colors before reaching for a secondary swatch.

content_islands.name: Principle
content_islands.spec: Keep the heading and explanation in a narrow left column on white.

content_islands.name: Color equation
content_islands.spec: Align a stack of flat core colors with two stacks of circular image crops. Distinguish photographs from illustrations and separate the three sources with plus signs.
